meta.title: Conspiracy beliefs
meta.question: Do Poles think hidden forces shape events?
meta.measure: Average belief that hidden forces or conspiracies shape events, from 0 (disbelief) to 10 (strong belief)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on whether hidden forces or conspiracies shape events in Poland and the world, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: It is not the government that rules us; those who really steer us are not known to us at all (strongly agree ... strongly disagree)
items.notes: CBOS 1995-09, 1996-01, 1996-08, 1999-09, 2002-03, 2010-10, 2010-11, 2015-08, 2015-09 (9 surveys). The PGSW item is the same question. From 24 October 2026 coded in the collapsed form CBOS's reports print (no 'definitely'/'rather' split), in the microdata as in the reports of 2018-2026, so that the item is one series to 2026.

items.wording: Those who say that there are powerful hidden forces in the world conspiring against Poland are largely right (strongly agree ... strongly disagree)
items.notes: CBOS 1995-09, 1996-08, 1999-09, 2002-03, 2010-10, 2010-11, 2015-08, 2015-09 (8 surveys). From 24 October 2026 coded in the collapsed form CBOS's reports print (no 'definitely'/'rather' split), in the microdata as in the reports of 2018-2026, so that the item is one series to 2026.

items.notes: ESS round 10 (2021-22): self-completion by web and paper in Poland, where every other round was face to face, so a question of its own.
